lines.en: Yeah. I feel pulled to wanting to tap into the light and to trust myself and to find that inner GPS.

lines.en: I honestly didn't know how, which is why I kept coming back to you.
lines.zh: 但老實說我不知道怎麼做，所以我一直回來找你。

lines.zh: 你會是那個讓一切安靜下來的聲音。

lines.en: And then I would start to practice what I was learning.

lines.en: And I would love to have you expand on this because I know the person that's thinking right now is is probably thinking, "Okay, well, easy for you, easy, easy for you, Oprah.
lines.zh: 我很希望你能多談談這一點，因為我知道此刻正在想的人，大概在想：「好吧，對你來說很簡單，很簡單，對你來說很簡單，Oprah。」

lines.en: Yes.

lines.zh: 這其實是一種轉移，因為當你開始責怪、被那個可能拯救你、幫助你、解放你的東西刺激到時，那代表你想要它，只是不知道怎麼做。

lines.en: Having sat with so many people that have found purpose and meaning and peace in their life versus people who are very stuck. Mhm.
lines.zh: 你和那麼多找到目標、意義和平靜的人坐下來談過，也和很多非常卡住的人談過。嗯。

lines.en: Is there a difference between those two people in terms of if somebody's very stuck right now?
lines.zh: 如果有人現在非常卡住，這兩種人之間有什麼差別嗎？

lines.en: Yeah, I think the difference is if you're very stuck right now, it's because you can't see the bigger picture.
lines.zh: 對，我想差別是，如果你現在非常卡住，是因為你看不見更大的圖像。

lines.en: You can't see that the source of all being didn't bring you here to get you stuck.
lines.zh: 你看不見那個萬物之源帶你來這裡，不是為了讓你卡住。

lines.en: It brought you here so that you can continue to move forward and offer what you came to give to the rest of us, to the rest of the world.
lines.zh: 它帶你來這裡，是為了讓你能繼續前進，把你帶來要給的東西，獻給我們其他人、獻給全世界。

lines.en: That's all we're all here to do is to bring our offerings.
lines.zh: 我們來這裡全都只為了一件事：獻上我們的禮物。

lines.en: And our offerings come from every lesson we've ever learned.
lines.zh: 而我們的禮物，來自我們學過的每一課。

lines.en: Don't you you you you see that now?

lines.zh: Maya 其實寫過一本書，我想是詩集，叫《I Wouldn't Take Nothing for My Journey Now》。

lines.en: But she used to sing the song. It's an old hymn.
lines.zh: 但她以前常唱這首歌，一首老聖詩。

lines.en: I wouldn't take nothing for my journey now. For my journey now. For my journey now.
lines.zh: 我不會拿任何東西換我這一路的旅程。這一路的旅程，這一路的旅程。

lines.en: Oh, I wouldn't take nothing for my journey now.
lines.zh: 喔，我不會拿任何東西換我這一路的旅程。

lines.en: And I that means all the stuff that was a part of the journey to this moment.
lines.zh: 那代表這一路走到此刻，所有經歷的一切。

lines.en: I wouldn't take nothing for it. Yeah.
lines.zh: 我不會拿任何東西來換。對。

lines.en: And I feel that and I want you to know that whatever has happened to you was also happening for you once you could recognize why it was happening to you no matter how horrible it was.
lines.zh: 我有這種感受，我也希望你知道，不管發生在你身上的是什麼，一旦你明白它為什麼發生，它也是為了你而發生的，不管它有多可怕。

lines.en: And that's why I can say in spite of the sexual abuse, in spite of growing up poor, not only in spite of, I am so grateful to have been born literally red dirt road poor in Mississippi with no running water and electricity.
lines.zh: 所以我才能說，儘管遭受過性侵、儘管在貧窮中長大，不只是「儘管」，我非常感恩自己出生在密西西比真正的紅土路貧困家庭，沒有自來水、沒有電。

lines.en: I am so grateful for that.
lines.zh: 我對此非常感恩。

lines.en: I am so grateful for having an outhouse and not knowing what a bathroom was for the first six years of my life. because it makes every darn time I flush my toilets like a wow experience.
lines.zh: 我很感恩有戶外廁所，人生頭六年根本不知道浴室是什麼。因為這讓我每次沖馬桶都覺得哇，好棒。

lines.en: I'm just like wow. So it makes it makes coming from that dirt road so much more thrilling that journey.
lines.zh: 我就是會想：哇。所以這讓我從那條泥土路走到今天的旅程，更加令人激動。

lines.en: If somebody's sitting there thinking right now, especially the line everything happens for you, Oprah. Yeah. I mean, come on.
lines.zh: 如果有人坐在那裡想，尤其是「一切都是為你而發生」這句話：Oprah，拜託。

lines.en: Like the the the things that are violent and terrifying and awful that I don't deserve.
lines.zh: 那些暴力的、可怕的、糟糕的、我不應得的事呢？

lines.en: How do you flip that in your mind so that the things that happened to you don't keep you there?
lines.zh: 你是怎麼在心裡翻轉，讓發生在你身上的事不會把你困在那裡？

lines.en: Like cuz there's a real flip there.
lines.zh: 因為那裡真的有一個轉折。

lines.en: Cuz you know, I've never liked that saying everything happens for a reason.
lines.zh: 因為你知道，我從來都不喜歡「凡事都有原因」這句話。

lines.en: I know. because I just believe that sometimes very cruel and unfair and horrible things happen to people who don't deserve them.
lines.zh: 我知道。因為我相信，有時候非常殘酷、不公平、可怕的事，會發生在不應該遭受這些的人身上。

lines.en: But I think a lot about how to truly grow and reclaim your life after something like that, you have to find a reason to move forward after it.
lines.zh: 但我常常在想，經歷過那樣的事之後，要真正成長、奪回自己的人生，你得找到一個繼續前進的理由。

lines.en: Can you just dig even deeper for the person who's really feeling like I don't know how to how to embrace everything happens for me as a mindset so I can move forward.
lines.zh: 你能不能再深入談談，對那些真的覺得「我不知道怎麼接受『一切都是為我而發生』這種心態、好讓自己繼續前進」的人？

lines.en: Well, when it happens, if you don't move forward, then you just get stuck and your life debilitates.
lines.zh: 嗯，當事情發生，如果你不往前走，你就會卡住，人生就會衰弱下去。

lines.en: And one of the things that becomes a debil a debilitating energy, a debilitating force field.
lines.zh: 而其中一件事會變成一種讓人虛弱的能量、讓人虛弱的力場。

lines.en: And so when I say it happens for a reason, I don't mean, oh, there's a reason for everything.
lines.zh: 所以當我說它的發生有原因，我不是說：喔，凡事都有原因。

lines.en: I mean that when that thing shows up for you that often feels unfair, that often you don't understand, why was I raped at nine?
lines.zh: 我的意思是，當那件常常讓你覺得不公平、常常讓你無法理解的事出現在你面前，像是：為什麼我九歲時被強暴？

lines.en: Why did that happen to me?
lines.zh: 為什麼那件事發生在我身上？

lines.en: I at the time couldn't see any good coming from it.
lines.zh: 我當時看不到任何好的結果。

lines.en: Um why did I have to grow up poor in Mississippi in an environment where it was illegal for black people to be on the street after dark?
lines.zh: 嗯，為什麼我得在密西西比貧窮地長大，在一個黑人天黑後上街就違法的環境裡？

lines.en: Um all the things that happened in in my family life.
lines.zh: 嗯，還有我家裡發生的所有事。

lines.en: Why why why was I raped again at 10 and 14? Why why why why?
lines.zh: 為什麼、為什麼我在 10 歲和 14 歲又被強暴？為什麼、為什麼、為什麼？

lines.en: I mean, I'm actually not supposed to be here.
lines.zh: 我是說，我其實根本不應該在這裡。

lines.en: And people have more horrific stories, unimaginable stories than mine and yours.
lines.zh: 而且有些人的故事比我們更可怕、更難以想像。

lines.en: So, I don't mean that like, oh, willy-nilly, like, oh, everything's happening and there's a reason for it.
lines.zh: 所以我不是隨隨便便地說：喔，一切的發生都有原因。

lines.en: There's a reason for everything, but it doesn't mean you're responsible for the reason or that that thing should have happened to you. Yes.
lines.zh: 每件事都有原因，但這不代表你要為那個原因負責，也不代表那件事就應該發生在你身上。對。

lines.en: And so, really bad things happen to me.
lines.zh: 所以，很糟糕的事發生在我身上。

lines.en: I grew up feeling very lonely and I know a lot of people grow up most people grow up not getting what they need.
lines.zh: 我從小就覺得非常孤單，我知道很多人、大多數人長大的過程中，都沒有得到他們需要的東西。

lines.en: I remember doing a show with John Bradshaw who is the founder of the whole inner child movement.
lines.zh: 我記得和 John Bradshaw 做過一集節目，他是整個「內在小孩」運動的創始人。

lines.en: John Bradshaw did an exercise where he had people go back into their childhoods and look through the window.
lines.zh: John Bradshaw 帶大家做了一個練習，讓人回到童年，透過窗戶往裡看。

lines.en: Walk yourself home and then look through the window of your home and what do you see?
lines.zh: 走回你小時候的家，透過家裡的窗戶往裡看，你看到了什麼？

lines.en: And I saw myself separated from my grandmother and my grandfather, but feeling very much alone.
lines.zh: 我看到自己和外婆、外公分開，覺得非常孤單。

lines.en: I don't actually remember feeling loved by my mother or my grandmother growing up.
lines.zh: 我其實不記得小時候有感受到媽媽或外婆的愛。

lines.en: I now know they loved me in the best way they knew how.
lines.zh: 我現在知道，她們是用她們知道的最好的方式在愛我。

lines.en: But I didn't feel it.
lines.zh: 但我沒有感受到。

lines.en: And because I didn't feel it and didn't get what I needed, that is what inspired me to be such a talker, that's to be a speaker, to be an orator, to do so well in school because that's where my validation came from.
lines.zh: 而正因為我沒有感受到、沒有得到我需要的，才促使我變得這麼會說話，成為演說者、成為講者，在學校表現得那麼好，因為那是我得到肯定的地方。

lines.en: I got I felt no validation from home.
lines.zh: 我在家裡得不到任何肯定。

lines.en: So I felt love from my teachers.
lines.zh: 所以我從老師那裡感受到愛。

lines.en: I felt pleasing my teachers ma made my teachers like me.
lines.zh: 我覺得討老師開心，就能讓老師喜歡我。

lines.en: I felt I felt a sense of satisfaction and worthiness outside my home, not inside my home.
lines.zh: 我是在家以外、而不是在家裡，感受到滿足感和自我價值。

lines.en: Because I didn't get that from the people that I needed it from.
lines.zh: 因為我沒有從我需要的人那裡得到。

lines.en: I got it from the world.
lines.zh: 我是從這個世界得到的。

lines.en: I got it from strangers. Yes.
lines.zh: 我是從陌生人那裡得到的。對。

lines.en: Because we all have a design for our lives.
lines.zh: 因為我們每個人的人生都有一個設計。

lines.en: You know, one of the things that impressed me uh so much to be able to find peace within my own family because I grew up, as I said, not feeling loved.
lines.zh: 你知道，讓我印象非常深刻的一件事，是能在自己的家庭裡找到平靜，因為就像我說的，我從小不覺得被愛。

lines.en: But once I became Oprah Winfrey, everybody loved me. Everybody.
lines.zh: 但我成為 Oprah Winfrey 之後，每個人都愛我。每個人。

lines.en: I was driving in Chicago and my mother was in the car and she goes, "We didn't have much, but we sure had love."
lines.zh: 有一次我在芝加哥開車，我媽媽在車上，她說：「我們以前雖然沒什麼錢，但我們有滿滿的愛。」

lines.en: I almost wrecked the car.
lines.zh: 我差點撞車。

lines.en: Like, what are you talking about? What? Who are you?
lines.zh: 我想：你在說什麼？什麼？你是誰？

lines.en: Who are you talking to?
lines.zh: 你在跟誰說話？

lines.en: I said, "What did you just say?"
lines.zh: 我說：「你剛剛說什麼？」

lines.en: She goes, "Well, we didn't have much, but we sure had love."
lines.zh: 她說：「嗯，我們以前雖然沒什麼錢，但我們有滿滿的愛。」

lines.en: When So, I know that I never felt it.
lines.zh: 所以，我知道我從來沒有感受到。

lines.en: I know that I was never shown it.
lines.zh: 我知道我從來沒有被表達過愛。

lines.en: I don't remember one moment ever when my mother ever complimented me or said, "I'm proud of you."
lines.zh: 我不記得媽媽曾經有任何一刻稱讚過我，或說「我以你為榮」。

lines.en: I do remember being young and reading in the house and it was summer and it was hot and I was s sitting in a corner reading and my mother goes, "What you doing in here sitting up in here reading in the house?
lines.zh: 我記得小時候在家看書，那是夏天，天氣很熱，我坐在角落看書，我媽媽說：「你在這裡幹嘛？坐在家裡看書？

lines.en: You need to get out there with all these other kids.

lines.en: You think you better than everybody else just sitting up in this house reading."
lines.zh: 你以為你比別人了不起，就坐在家裡看書。」

lines.en: So, I remember being punished for wanting to read.
lines.zh: 所以我記得我因為想看書而被處罰。

lines.en: I I don't ever remember, but I made peace with my mother.
lines.zh: 我從來不記得……但我和媽媽和解了。

lines.en: I made peace long before she died. Well,
lines.zh: 我在她過世前很久就和她和解了。嗯，

lines.en: this is one of the pivotal things that I learned from you and it was the like life class that you did with T.D. Jakes and I would love for you to share what he taught you because it forever changed my ability to see thing people in my life very differently.
lines.zh: 這是我從你身上學到最關鍵的事情之一，就是你和 T.D. Jakes 做的那集「人生課」，我很希望你分享他教你的東西，因為那永遠改變了我看待生命中某些人的方式。

lines.en: Could you explain cuz that was Oh, that was a f fantastic life class that I did with him and I it actually struck me too cuz I remember crying like tears just shot out flowing when he said that because it was so affirming for me.
lines.zh: 你能解釋一下嗎？因為那是……喔，那是我和他做過很棒的一堂人生課，其實也深深打動了我，我記得他說那句話時我眼淚直接流下來，因為那對我來說是一種肯定。

lines.en: He said that you're a 10-gallon person. I'm a 10-gon person.
lines.zh: 他說你是 10 加侖的人。我是 10 加侖的人。

lines.en: A lot of you are 10-gallon people trying to get 10-gallons worth of love from pint-sized people who cannot carry the 10-gallons.
lines.zh: 你們很多人是 10 加侖的人，卻想從只有一品脫容量、根本裝不下 10 加侖的人身上得到 10 加侖的愛。

lines.en: They can't even carry the gallon.
lines.zh: 他們連一加侖都裝不下。

lines.en: You're looking for 10-gallon love, 10-gallon responses, 10-gallon reception, 10-gallon acceptance from people who have a pint-sized ability.
lines.zh: 你在尋找 10 加侖的愛、10 加侖的回應、10 加侖的接納、10 加侖的認同，而對方只有一品脫的能力。

lines.en: So what I learned from that is that expecting people to offer you or give you the love, the attention that you need who do not have the capacity to do it.
lines.zh: 所以我學到的是：期待沒有能力的人給你所需要的愛和關注。

lines.en: They just they don't have the they don't have it.
lines.zh: 他們就是、他們就是沒有。

lines.en: And you have to recognize they don't have it.
lines.zh: 而你必須認清他們就是沒有。

lines.en: So what do they have?
lines.zh: 那他們有什麼？

lines.en: Can I accept you exactly where you are with what you do have?
lines.zh: 我能不能接受你現在的樣子、接受你所擁有的？

lines.en: And so my mother could cook.
lines.zh: 我媽媽很會做菜。

lines.en: She made some an incredible collard greens and could make cornbread like nobody else.
lines.zh: 她做的羽衣甘藍一絕，玉米麵包也做得無人能比。

lines.en: And she and that was the way she offered love and her idea just like I know a lot of you have grown up with with parents especially if you're my generation or below my generation.
lines.zh: 而她、那就是她表達愛的方式，她的想法就像我知道你們很多人從小遇到的父母一樣，尤其是我這一代或更早的人。

lines.en: You have parents who thought because I provided for you that was love.
lines.zh: 你們的父母認為：我養你，這就是愛。

lines.en: You had food on the table. You had shelter.
lines.zh: 你桌上有飯吃，你有地方住。

lines.en: You weren't on the streets.
lines.zh: 你沒有流落街頭。

lines.en: That was that was that was all I had.
lines.zh: 那就是、那就是、那就是我能給的全部。

lines.en: That was all I had.
lines.zh: 那就是我能給的全部。

lines.en: And I realize now my mother was a was a was a maid her entire life until I retired her.
lines.zh: 我現在明白了，我媽媽一輩子都在當女傭，直到我讓她退休。

lines.en: My grandmother was a maid, a domestic worker.
lines.zh: 我外婆也是女傭，是幫傭。

lines.en: And taking care of other people's kids.
lines.zh: 照顧別人家的孩子。

lines.en: You're giving all of your energy to taking care of other people's kids. putting on the face for them, wearing the mask for them, and by the time you came home, you had nothing left for me.
lines.zh: 你把所有精力都花在照顧別人家的孩子，在他們面前強顏歡笑、戴著面具，等你回到家，已經沒有任何東西可以給我了。

lines.en: I recognize that now. And I forgive that.
lines.zh: 我現在明白了，我也原諒了。

lines.en: And you know, my favorite definition.
lines.zh: 你知道，我最喜歡的定義。

lines.en: Oh, well, I'm going to let you say it cuz this changed my life, too. Your definition of forgiveness.
lines.zh: 喔，我讓你來說，因為這也改變了我的人生：你對原諒的定義。

lines.en: Yes. is giving up the hope that the past could be any different.
lines.zh: 對，就是放棄「過去可能會有所不同」的希望。

lines.en: If you are still wishing, hoping, wanting what happened to you to be something different than what it was, that will leave you so stuck.
lines.zh: 如果你還在期望、希望、渴望發生在你身上的事能跟實際發生的不一樣，那會讓你一直卡住。

lines.en: So for you forgive for yourself, you forgive. you forgive to say I am going to release this thing that happened to me and ex first of all get to the stage that requires all of us to move forward and that is acceptance.
lines.zh: 所以原諒是為了你自己，你原諒，是在說：我要放下發生在我身上的這件事。首先要走到我們每個人都需要的那個階段，才能往前走，那就是接受。

lines.en: You know Elisabeth Kübler-Ross in her famous you know five stages of grief. Yeah.
lines.zh: 你知道 Elisabeth Kübler-Ross 那個著名的悲傷五階段。對。

lines.en: You know, you you go through denial and you go through anger about it and you go through telling yourself it could be different and then you get to acceptance.
lines.zh: 你會經歷否認，會對它感到憤怒，會一直告訴自己事情本來可以不一樣，然後你才走到接受。

lines.en: When you get to acceptance, when you've lost someone or any other job or relationship, when you get to acceptance, acceptance leads you to freedom.
lines.zh: 當你走到接受，不管是失去了某個人，還是失去工作或一段關係，當你走到接受，接受會帶你走向自由。

lines.en: And until you get there, you're still just living in the past.
lines.zh: 在走到那裡之前，你都還活在過去。

lines.en: You're hoping that it could be different.
lines.zh: 你還在希望它能有所不同。

lines.en: That is that is the best definition I I've ever known.
lines.zh: 那是、那是我所知道最好的定義。

lines.en: It's hard to apply when you first hear it because there's so much holding on to and bargaining with and wishing things were different and the wishing things were different.
lines.zh: 一開始聽到時很難做到，因為會有太多的緊抓不放、討價還價，還有希望事情能不一樣。

lines.en: Whether it's wishing this tragedy didn't happen or wishing the mom or the dad could have been a 10-gallon person even though they're a pint-sized person.
lines.zh: 不管是希望這場悲劇沒有發生，還是希望媽媽或爸爸能是 10 加侖的人，即使他們只有一品脫。

lines.en: It keeps the pain alive. Yeah. Oh my gosh. It's Mel. I have an invitation.
lines.zh: 那會讓痛苦一直延續下去。對。天啊。我是 Mel，我有一個邀請。

lines.en: I want you to come with me to Vegas to experience something extraordinary with Oprah Winfrey. Yes.
lines.zh: 我希望你跟我一起去拉斯維加斯，和 Oprah Winfrey 一起體驗一件非凡的事。對。

lines.en: It's the ultimate aha moment. It's not a show. It's an experience.
lines.zh: 這是終極的「頓悟時刻」。它不是一場秀，而是一場體驗。

lines.en: It's to be felt, not just seen.
lines.zh: 它是要用心去感受，不只是用眼睛看。

lines.en: This is at Sphere and it's not a speech. It's not a show. It's an immersive experience.
lines.zh: 地點在 Sphere，這不是演講、不是表演，而是一場沉浸式體驗。

lines.en: I cannot wait to be in the audience with you, Oprah. Yeah.
lines.zh: 我等不及要和你一起坐在觀眾席了，Oprah。對。

lines.en: I have had this dream for quite a while and I want people to come along and experience consistent aha moments of awe, wonder and joy.
lines.zh: 我有這個夢想很久了，我希望大家一起來，體驗一個接一個充滿敬畏、驚奇和喜悅的頓悟時刻。

lines.en: Ah, I need wonder. I need joy. I need the connection.
lines.zh: 啊，我需要驚奇，我需要喜悅，我需要那份連結。

lines.en: I cannot wait to experience what you've put together. Aha.
lines.zh: 我等不及要體驗你準備的東西了。Aha。

lines.en: April 2nd through the 4th live at Sphere.
lines.zh: 4 月 2 日到 4 日，在 Sphere 現場舉行。

lines.en: It's a call to wonder. A call to joy.
lines.zh: 這是一場對驚奇、對喜悅的召喚。

lines.en: To joy and the ultimate aha moment.
lines.zh: 對喜悅，還有終極的頓悟時刻。

lines.en: Visit ahalive.com for pre-sale sign up and travel packages.
lines.zh: 請上 ahalive.com 登記預售，還有旅遊套裝行程。

lines.en: And you better go fast.
lines.zh: 而且你最好快一點。

lines.en: I already got my tickets.
lines.zh: 我已經買好票了。

lines.en: I'm going with my daughters and some Oh my gosh.
lines.zh: 我要和我的女兒們還有……天啊。

lines.en: I'll see you in the audience.
lines.zh: 觀眾席見。

lines.en: You talked about how you had a job in the beginning hosting a show. Yeah.
lines.zh: 你說過你一開始只是一份主持節目的工作。對。

lines.en: And then you had an awakening when you realized through the power of your intention, you could use this platform as a force for good.
lines.zh: 然後你有了覺醒，明白透過你的意圖，可以把這個平台當成行善的力量。

lines.en: You know, in the beginning, I was just I was just doing a job just like so many people that are listening to us and watching us right now.
lines.zh: 你知道，一開始我就只是在做一份工作，就像現在很多正在聽我們、看我們的人一樣。

lines.en: I was just working at a job.
lines.zh: 我就只是在上班。

lines.en: But that decision to change my job and my work into a force for good to actually use it as not just a show to recognize it's not just a show but you have a platform here and you can use this to help other people see themselves but you know I had got caught up into the whole you know confrontational television and My producers were so proud of themselves because they had gotten a a a guy to come on with his mistress and his wife,
lines.zh: 但我決定把我的工作轉變成一股行善的力量，不只是把它當成一個節目，而是明白：這不只是節目，你有一個平台，可以用來幫助別人看見自己。但你知道，我那時被捲進了那種衝突型的電視節目，我的製作人很得意，因為他們找到一個男人帶著他的情婦和太太一起上節目，

lines.en: which unheard of that you can get the three of them together. Wow. On national television.
lines.zh: 能讓他們三個一起上節目，那是前所未聞的。哇。在全國電視上。

lines.en: So, they were on the show and I had no idea.
lines.zh: 所以他們上了節目，而我完全不知道。

lines.en: I mean, I'd read the background and he was having the affair and she was he, this was not in our, you know, in our preview.
lines.zh: 我是說，我讀過背景資料，知道他有外遇，但這不在我們的事前資料裡。

lines.en: And so he says to her on the air to his wife, he turns to his wife and he says, "Well, what you don't know is that she's pregnant."
lines.zh: 然後他在節目上轉頭對他太太說：「你不知道的是，她懷孕了。」

lines.en: And I'm telling you, the audience gasped. I gasped.
lines.zh: 我跟你說，觀眾倒抽一口氣，我也倒抽一口氣。

lines.en: And I looked at her face and I said, "Never again will that happen to me. Never again."
lines.zh: 我看著她的臉，我說：「這種事再也不會發生在我身上了。再也不會。」

lines.en: I was so angry with myself and angry upset with the producers who were so proud of themselves and they go, "We didn't know he was going to say that.
lines.zh: 我對自己非常生氣，也對那些很得意的製作人很不滿，他們說：「我們不知道他會那樣說。

lines.en: We didn't know he was going to say because her humiliation still abides with me."
lines.zh: 我們不知道他會那樣說。」而她的羞辱至今仍留在我心裡。

lines.en: M but was a great teacher for me cuz I thought the worst thing you can ever do if y'all are listening if you're listening right now the worst thing you can ever do to anybody is to cause them to be humiliated.
lines.zh: 嗯，但那是很好的一課，因為我想，如果你們在聽，如果你現在在聽，你對任何人能做的最糟糕的事，就是讓他們感到羞辱。

lines.en: That's why if you've got to criticize somebody, if you have something to say to somebody that's going to be hurtful or is going to put them in a position where they feel devastated,
lines.zh: 所以如果你必須批評某人，如果你有會傷人的話要對某人說，或是會讓他們覺得崩潰的話，

lines.en: you never ever ever do that in front of other people. because then they have the humiliation and then the shame of it.
lines.zh: 絕對、絕對、絕對不要在別人面前說。因為那樣他們會感到羞辱，還有隨之而來的羞恥。

lines.en: So I said to myself, I c I I can't I I cannot live with myself doing that to somebody.
lines.zh: 所以我對自己說，我、我無法……我無法原諒自己對別人做那種事。

lines.en: And I apologized to her afterwards and him afterwards.
lines.zh: 節目結束後我向她道歉，也向他道歉。

lines.en: We're on live television, though. We're on live television.
lines.zh: 但我們是在電視直播。我們是在電視直播。

lines.en: I know she never got over it cuz I have still to this day never gotten over it.
lines.zh: 我知道她永遠不會釋懷，因為我到今天都還沒釋懷。

lines.en: And I said to my producers, "Never again will that happen.
lines.zh: 我對我的製作人說：「這種事再也不會發生。

lines.en: We're not doing that anymore."
lines.zh: 我們不再做這種節目了。」

lines.en: Cuz around this time, 19 in the late 1980s, I was reading Gary Zukav's book, The Seat of the Soul.
lines.zh: 因為大約在那個時候，1980 年代後期，我在讀 Gary Zukav 的書《The Seat of the Soul》。

lines.en: And in that book, one of the best books of my life actually, and he has two chapters on intention.
lines.zh: 那本書其實是我一生中讀過最好的書之一，其中有兩章在講意圖。

lines.en: And he talks about intention being one with cause and effect.
lines.zh: 他說意圖和因果是一體的。

lines.en: And you all know that cause and effect is the first is the law of karma.
lines.zh: 大家都知道，因果就是業力法則。

lines.en: It is what you put out is coming back.
lines.zh: 你付出什麼，就會回來什麼。

lines.en: And when I got that, I got it.
lines.zh: 當我懂了這一點，我就真的懂了。

lines.en: It changed everything for me because I used to be such a huge people pleaser.
lines.zh: 它改變了我的一切，因為我以前是個超級討好別人的人。

lines.en: I didn't know how to say no.
lines.zh: 我不知道怎麼說不。

lines.en: And what I learned from the principle of intention is that if you're saying yes because you want to please the person, that is what they feel.
lines.zh: 而我從意圖的原則中學到的是：如果你說好是因為你想討好對方，對方感受到的就是那個。

lines.en: They feel your pleasure. They feel your acquiescence.
lines.zh: 他們感受到你的樂意，感受到你的順從。

lines.en: They feel your desire to make them feel okay.
lines.zh: 他們感受到你想讓他們感覺舒服的心意。

lines.en: They don't know that behind it you are resentful. You don't know.
lines.zh: 他們不知道在那背後你其實心懷怨恨。你不知道。

lines.en: They don't recognize that behind it you really didn't want to do it cuz you said you wanted to. You said yes. Yeah.
lines.zh: 他們沒發現在那背後你其實不想做，因為你說了你想做，你說了好。對。

lines.en: So, as soon as I got clear on, oh, the reason why people keep coming back is because they are feeling my intention of wanting to please them and not wanting to hurt their feelings.
lines.zh: 所以當我想清楚了：喔，大家一直回來找我，是因為他們感受到我想討好他們、不想傷他們感情的意圖。

lines.en: So, I don't hurt their feelings.
lines.zh: 所以我不會傷他們的感情。

lines.en: Not only do I not hurt their feelings, I make them feel pretty good.
lines.zh: 不只不傷他們的感情，還讓他們感覺很好。

lines.en: That's why when you loan money or you give something or you're the person who's carpooling and they always ask you to be the carpooler, it's because they know when they come to you, you're going to say yes.
lines.zh: 這就是為什麼當你借錢給別人、給別人東西，或你是那個共乘的人，他們總是找你開車，是因為他們知道來找你，你一定會說好。

lines.en: And so when I learned to say no, when I learned to say no, that for myself, I then carried that principle of intention.
lines.zh: 所以當我學會說不，當我為自己學會說不之後，我把這個意圖的原則延續下去。

lines.en: I sat down with all the producers and said, "We're no longer going to do a show unless we come from the point of view of intention."
lines.zh: 我和所有製作人坐下來說：「除非我們從意圖的角度出發，否則我們不再做任何一集節目。」

lines.en: So when you present me the ideas, I want the intention for the idea alongside the idea. Yes.
lines.zh: 所以當你們提出點子時，我要看到點子背後的意圖。對。

lines.en: And so every show then after 1989 became designed around the intention of how are we going to let people be enlightened,
lines.zh: 所以 1989 年之後的每一集節目，都是圍繞著這個意圖設計的：我們要怎麼讓大家得到啟發、

lines.en: uplift them, see something today, hear something today that's an aha moment for them that changes the direction for them.
lines.zh: 讓他們振奮，今天看到或聽到某件事，成為改變他們方向的頓悟時刻。

lines.en: Yes, you as you're listening or watching right now, you have a platform right in front of your face. It's your family. It's your community.
lines.zh: 對，正在聽或看的你，眼前就有一個平台。那是你的家庭、你的社區。

lines.en: And through the power of your intention, you can start to be a force for good exactly where you are.
lines.zh: 透過你意圖的力量，你可以在你所在的地方，開始成為一股行善的力量。

lines.en: And I would say, let me just say to you, if you're just at a job right now, shift the paradigm in your mind about the why you're doing that job.
lines.zh: 而我想說，讓我跟你說，如果你現在只是在做一份工作，轉換一下你心中對「為什麼做這份工作」的想法。

lines.en: Even if you say, "Well, I'm just doing this job uh to make money for my family because I've got to make ends meet."
lines.zh: 就算你說：「嗯，我做這份工作只是為了替家人賺錢，因為我得維持生計。」

lines.en: Then let every single step you take in that job, every single move you make in that job, even though that job may be boring and even though that job may be irritating to you, let it be for the love of your family.
lines.zh: 那就讓你在那份工作中的每一步、每一個動作，即使那份工作可能很無聊、可能讓你很煩，都為了你對家人的愛。

lines.en: Never, ever, ever lose sight every day you're walking out of the door.
lines.zh: 每天走出家門時，永遠、永遠、永遠不要忘記這一點。

lines.en: This I do for the love of my family.
lines.zh: 我這麼做，是出於對家人的愛。

lines.en: This I do to show that I am a provider and one who can offer to my family a sense of safety, a sense of comfort.
lines.zh: 我這麼做，是為了證明我是一個能養家、能給家人安全感和安心感的人。

lines.en: Just that little shift makes a difference in the way the work day moves.
lines.zh: 光是這個小小的轉變，就能改變你一天工作的感受。

lines.en: And whatever the job or the work is to be able to shift it to how do I use this thing that I'm doing that is boring the hell out of me or that is irritating to me and I got a boss.
lines.zh: 不管是什麼工作，都能轉換成：我要怎麼運用這件讓我無聊透頂、讓我很煩、還有個老闆管著的事？

lines.en: How do I use this in service to something greater than myself?
lines.zh: 我要怎麼用它來服務比我自己更大的東西？

lines.en: How do I use this to serve?
lines.zh: 我要怎麼用它來付出？

lines.en: And you know, I've had these conversations with people who have supposedly, you know, you know, dull jobs and whatever.
lines.zh: 你知道，我和一些做著所謂枯燥工作的人聊過。

lines.en: And I sat down with a guy one day and by the end of the our little conversation, he was crying.
lines.zh: 有一天我和一個男人坐下來聊，聊到最後他哭了。

lines.en: I was saying, "So, why do you do this work?
lines.zh: 我問他：「你為什麼做這份工作？

lines.en: And what are you doing it for?"
lines.zh: 你是為了什麼在做？」

lines.en: And what does he goes?
lines.zh: 他說什麼呢？

lines.en: Well, I'm just just, you know, I I got to pay the bills.
lines.zh: 嗯，我只是、只是，你知道，我得付帳單。

lines.en: And so, you're paying the bills for what? I'm paying the bills.
lines.zh: 那你付帳單是為了什麼？我在付帳單。

lines.en: So my family can eat and and you're paying the bill so your family can eat and who is your family and tell me about your daughter and yeah.
lines.zh: 好讓我家人有飯吃。你付帳單是為了讓家人有飯吃，那你的家人是誰？跟我說說你女兒。對。

lines.en: So when you change the paradigm of what you're doing and shift why you're doing it to an intention behind doing it, it it it lightens it.
lines.zh: 所以當你改變對自己在做的事的觀念，把為什麼做轉變成背後的意圖，它、它、它就變輕了。

lines.en: It lightens it. Cuz if we go back to some of your teaching, the energy you put out is the energy you get back.
lines.zh: 它就變輕了。因為如果回到你的一些教導：你付出什麼能量，就會得到什麼能量。

lines.en: So if you are bargaining with life and not able to accept it, the energy is resistance. Absolutely.
lines.zh: 所以如果你在和人生討價還價、無法接受它，那股能量就是抗拒。沒錯。

lines.en: And if you're in the energy of resistance, you're going to be stuck in resistance.
lines.zh: 如果你處在抗拒的能量中，你就會卡在抗拒裡。

lines.en: And so I often ask myself, if something's not going the way I want, what is it I'm resisting? Oh, okay.
lines.zh: 所以我常常問自己：如果某件事的發展不如我意，我在抗拒什麼？喔，好。

lines.en: So, if you're in a like, can you put give me an example?
lines.zh: 所以如果你在……你能給我一個例子嗎？

lines.en: Something's not going the way you want and you're starting to feel bothered by it or upset or stuck. Yeah.
lines.zh: 某件事的發展不如你意，你開始覺得困擾、心煩或卡住。對。

lines.en: You ask yourself, what am I resisting? What am I resisting?
lines.zh: 你就問自己：我在抗拒什麼？我在抗拒什麼？

lines.en: Creating peace of mind is truly at the heart of their mission.
lines.zh: 創造安心，是他們使命的核心。

lines.en: And whether you're protecting your home, your car, or everything in between, Amica knows it's not just about where you're going, but who you go with.
lines.zh: 不管你是在保護你的家、你的車，或兩者之間的一切，Amica 知道重點不只是你要去哪裡，還有你和誰同行。

lines.en: When you choose Amica, you're choosing a partner who's with you every step of the way.
lines.zh: 選擇 Amica，你就是選擇一個陪你走每一步的夥伴。

lines.en: Peace of mind starts with the right partner.
lines.zh: 安心從對的夥伴開始。

lines.en: Visit amica.com and get a quote today.
lines.zh: 今天就上 amica.com 取得報價。

lines.en: I want to read to you this passage in your blockbuster bestsellers.
lines.zh: 我想為你讀一段你的超級暢銷書裡的文字。

lines.en: This is the 10th anniversary edition.
lines.zh: 這是十週年紀念版。

lines.en: What I know for sure.
lines.zh: 《我確實知道的事》。

lines.en: What I love about this book is that it's all essays from O magazine and that you wrote and as I read each one, I can remember reading it.
lines.zh: 我喜歡這本書的地方是，它收錄的都是你在《O》雜誌寫的文章，我每讀一篇，都記得當初讀過。

lines.en: Oh, really? Cuz you read every magazine. Oh, did I? Ever. I was a student. I was a student. Um I love this.
lines.zh: 喔，真的嗎？因為你每一期雜誌都讀。喔，是嗎？每一期。我是你的學生，我是你的學生。嗯，我很愛這段。

lines.en: This is on page 39.
lines.zh: 這是第 39 頁。

lines.en: Whenever I'm faced with a difficult decision, I ask myself, "What would I do if I weren't afraid of making mistake, feeling rejected, looking foolish, or being alone?"
lines.zh: 每當我面對困難的決定，我會問自己：「如果我不怕犯錯、不怕被拒絕、不怕看起來很蠢、不怕孤單，我會怎麼做？」

lines.en: I know for sure that when you remove the fear, the answer you've been searching for comes into focus.
lines.zh: 我確實知道，當你移除恐懼，你一直在尋找的答案就會變得清晰。

lines.en: And as you walk into what you fear, you should know for sure that your deepest struggle can, and if you're willing and open, produce your greatest strength.
lines.zh: 而當你走進你所恐懼的事物，你應該確實知道：只要你願意、心胸開放，你最深的掙扎可以造就你最大的力量。

lines.en: Mhm. for the person who's listening right now and like in those moments when you're afraid and you start to question everything. Mhm.
lines.zh: 嗯。對正在聽的人來說，在那些你害怕、開始質疑一切的時刻。嗯。

lines.en: How do you find the truth when the fear is so loud?
lines.zh: 當恐懼那麼大聲時，你要怎麼找到真相？

lines.en: Cuz the truth can feel quiet or or scary.
lines.zh: 因為真相可能感覺很安靜，或很可怕。

lines.en: This reminds me of uh moving from Baltimore to Chicago and everybody around me telling me that the move to Chicago was going to destroy me and that I was living in Baltimore and you're you're doing well and you're an anchor woman and you should just keep this job.
lines.zh: 這讓我想起從巴爾的摩搬到芝加哥，身邊每個人都告訴我，搬到芝加哥會毀了我，說我在巴爾的摩過得很好，你是新聞主播，你應該保住這份工作就好。

lines.en: And my father, my own father was like, "Well, you're not going to ever find a job like this again." uh and it was safe.
lines.zh: 我父親、我自己的父親也說：「嗯，你再也找不到這樣的工作了。」嗯，而且那很安穩。

lines.en: But this is this is the most important thing.
lines.zh: 但這、這是最重要的事。

lines.en: Understanding that the source whatever you call it from which you've come has put you here for a greater reason than whatever the small thing in front of you is. whatever you're looking at is only a piece of the picture of your whole life.
lines.zh: 要明白，那個你從中而來的源頭，不管你怎麼稱呼它，把你放在這裡，是為了一個比你眼前那件小事更大的理由。你眼前看到的一切，都只是你整個人生圖像的一小塊。

lines.en: So one of the reasons why I've been able to maintain the center of myself is because even in that moment of struggle with own in the beginning of building that network I was sad I was numbed I was depressed I was angry with myself but I knew trouble don't last always I knew that that too would eventually pass I didn't know how because I live in the center of knowing that there's bigger reason why I'm here.
lines.zh: 所以我能維持內心中心的原因之一，是即使在 OWN 電視網創立初期那段掙扎的時刻，我很難過、我麻木了、我很沮喪、我對自己很生氣，但我知道困難不會永遠持續，我知道那也終將過去。我不知道會怎麼過去，但因為我活在「知道我來這裡有更大的理由」這個核心之中。

lines.en: And I have always understood that.
lines.zh: 而我一直都明白這一點。

lines.en: I've always understood that I am a child of the universe. I am God's child.
lines.zh: 我一直都明白，我是宇宙的孩子，我是上帝的孩子。

lines.en: I am born to Vernon and Verita Lee.
lines.zh: 我是 Vernon 和 Vernita Lee 的孩子。

lines.en: But my coming here is such a freaking miracle.
lines.zh: 但我的到來真的是一個天大的奇蹟。

lines.en: My parents were only together one time. One time.
lines.zh: 我父母只在一起過一次。一次。

lines.en: They never It was literally a one afternoon delight stand.
lines.zh: 他們從來沒有……那真的只是一個下午的露水之歡。

lines.en: It wasn't even a one night stand. One time. And I born colored.
lines.zh: 連一夜情都算不上。就一次。而我生來是「有色人種」。

lines.en: We weren't even black then.
lines.zh: 那時我們甚至還不叫黑人。

lines.en: Colored in Mississippi where the dream for a colored girl, the dream for a colored girl did not exist.
lines.zh: 在密西西比是「有色人種」，而對一個有色人種女孩來說，夢想根本不存在。

lines.en: So this miracle that has become my life I know exists for everybody who is willing to tap into the source of themselves to that and that's what has eliminated my my my my ultimate fears.
lines.zh: 所以這個成為我人生的奇蹟，我知道對每個願意連結內在源頭的人都存在，而這就消除了我最深的恐懼。

lines.en: I mean, I was I've been anxious about things, but I know that ultimately I belong to something bigger than myself and that my reason for being here is bigger than a job or bigger than what I could even know.
lines.zh: 我是說，我也曾為一些事焦慮，但我知道說到底，我屬於一個比我自己更大的東西，我來這裡的理由比一份工作更大，甚至比我能理解的還要大。

lines.en: And so my my message and my offering to your audience is to ask the life force to use you for its highest good.
lines.zh: 所以我的訊息、我要獻給你的觀眾的，是請求生命的力量，為了最高的良善來運用你。

lines.en: Not you just tell it what you want to use you for its highest good.
lines.zh: 不是你告訴它你想要什麼，而是讓它為了最高的良善來運用你。

lines.en: I I I will share this story.
lines.zh: 我、我、我要分享這個故事。

lines.en: There was there was a producer of mine in Baltimore who was the richest person I'd ever seen or known.
lines.zh: 我在巴爾的摩有一位製作人，她是我見過或認識最有錢的人。

lines.en: Her name was Arlene Weiner.
lines.zh: 她叫 Arlene Weiner。

lines.en: Her husband's a famous attorney there.
lines.zh: 她先生是當地很有名的律師。

lines.en: And they I went to her house in when I was 28, 29 years old.
lines.zh: 我 28、29 歲時去過她家。

lines.en: And she had us all over.
lines.zh: 她請我們所有人過去。

lines.en: And I was like, "Wow, Arlene is rich."
lines.zh: 我想：「哇，Arlene 好有錢。」

lines.en: And I went into her home and there it is looking out the window.
lines.zh: 我走進她家，往窗外一看。

lines.en: All these trees in the front yard just like I counted six trees out of her window.
lines.zh: 前院有好多樹，我從她家窗戶數到六棵樹。

lines.en: I thought, "Wow, if I ever get some money, I'm going to have me some trees.
lines.zh: 我想：「哇，如果我有一天有錢了，我也要有一些樹。

lines.en: I don't care about the cars, but I'm going to have me some trees."
lines.zh: 我不在乎車子，但我要有一些樹。」

lines.en: And one morning I was sitting in the uh kitchen waiting on the the water to boil making tea and I looked out the window and there were the six trees.
lines.zh: 有一天早上，我坐在廚房等水煮開泡茶，往窗外一看，那裡有六棵樹。

lines.en: I went whoa. There were those trees that I'd seen in Arlene's yard.
lines.zh: 我說：哇。就是我在 Arlene 家院子看到的那六棵樹。

lines.en: And I walked out around to the porch and I loo counted the trees, but I couldn't even count all of the trees.
lines.zh: 我走到門廊去數樹，但我根本數不完。

lines.en: I could see the six from the window, but I couldn't see the hundreds beyond the six through the window.
lines.zh: 我從窗戶看得到那六棵，但透過窗戶看不到那六棵後面的數百棵。

lines.en: So, I literally You've been to my home.
lines.zh: 所以我真的……你去過我家。

lines.en: I live in a forest. Yeah.
lines.zh: 我住在一座森林裡。對。

lines.en: I had a dream for six trees.
lines.zh: 我夢想有六棵樹。

lines.en: My dream was six trees.
lines.zh: 我的夢想是六棵樹。

lines.en: The life force that I call God had a bigger dream for me.
lines.zh: 而我稱為上帝的生命力量，為我懷抱了更大的夢想。

lines.en: And that is my message.
lines.zh: 這就是我的訊息。

lines.en: Whatever dream you're dreaming, surrender that dream to the force that brought you here, regardless of what name you give that force.
lines.zh: 不管你在做什麼夢，把那個夢交託給帶你來到這裡的力量，不管你怎麼稱呼那股力量。

lines.en: Because what I know is the force by all the names that we call God, ain't jealous about the name.
lines.zh: 因為我知道，那股力量，不管我們用什麼名字稱呼上帝，都不會在意名字。

lines.en: You know, it's ain't going to be jealous about the name.
lines.zh: 你知道，它不會為了名字吃醋。

lines.en: It's not going to say, "Oh, you didn't call me Allah.
lines.zh: 它不會說：「喔，你沒叫我阿拉。

lines.en: You didn't call me Jehovah.
lines.zh: 你沒叫我耶和華。

lines.en: You didn't call me God." Okay?
lines.zh: 你沒叫我上帝。」好嗎？

lines.en: Whatever you call that, whatever that is, the life force that brought you here.
lines.zh: 不管你怎麼稱呼它、不管它是什麼，那股帶你來這裡的生命力量。

lines.en: Lean into that dream for you.
lines.zh: 全心投入它為你懷抱的夢想。

lines.en: Cuz there is a dream for your life, for your life, for my life.
lines.zh: 因為你的人生、你的人生、我的人生，都有一個夢想。

lines.en: Don't live in your little small six tree dream.
lines.zh: 不要活在你那個只有六棵樹的小夢想裡。

lines.en: Don't live it live in the forest of dreams for yourself. Lean into that.
lines.zh: 不要活在……要活在屬於你的夢想森林裡。全心投入吧。

lines.en: And I think the reason why people are so stuck because they can't see their connection to the thing that's greater than themselves.
lines.zh: 我覺得大家之所以這麼卡住，是因為他們看不見自己和那個比自己更大的東西之間的連結。

lines.en: Your life isn't this small.
lines.zh: 你的人生不是這麼小。

lines.en: It's it it belongs to the world.
lines.zh: 它、它屬於這個世界。

lines.en: It belongs to the world.
lines.zh: 它屬於這個世界。

lines.en: The reason why we're all here is to give to the world. To give to myself.
lines.zh: 我們都在這裡的原因，是為了給予這個世界。也給予自己。

lines.en: To feed myself. to take the lessons that I have learned to go forward to understand what happened to me happened to me so that I can use it.
lines.zh: 滋養自己。把我學到的課帶著往前走，明白發生在我身上的事之所以發生，是為了讓我能運用它。

lines.en: I was raped so that I could help other women who were raped.
lines.zh: 我被強暴，是為了能幫助其他被強暴的女人。

lines.en: I was not seen so that I could see other people.
lines.zh: 我不被看見，是為了能看見別人。

lines.en: All the things that I didn't get, I now can give to other people as can you.
lines.zh: 所有我沒得到的，我現在都能給別人，你也可以。

lines.en: As can you as you are doing that's what it's for.
lines.zh: 你也可以，就像你正在做的，那就是它的意義。

lines.en: When you say it's all happening for a reason. Oh my goodness.
lines.zh: 當你說一切的發生都有原因。天啊。

lines.en: It's happening so that it feeds and fuels you in a way that you have more to give.
lines.zh: 它的發生，是為了滋養你、給你動力，讓你有更多可以給予。

lines.en: That's the lesson that we're missing.
lines.zh: 這就是我們錯過的那一課。

lines.en: And we're missing it because we're so we're so narrowly tracked.
lines.zh: 而我們錯過它，是因為我們的視野太窄了。

lines.en: We're like in our phones and and you think your life is this big.
lines.zh: 我們整天盯著手機，你以為你的人生就這麼大。

lines.en: You think your life is this big, but it belongs to the world. Belongs to the world.
lines.zh: 你以為你的人生就這麼大，但它屬於這個世界。屬於這個世界。

lines.en: And I want you to really pay attention because I remember moments in my life where my life felt so small.
lines.zh: 我希望你真的好好注意，因為我記得人生中有些時刻，我的人生感覺好渺小。

lines.en: The job I hated, the relationship I didn't have the courage to get out of, the debt that I was in, the anxiety I was feeling.
lines.zh: 我討厭的工作、我沒有勇氣離開的關係、我背負的債務、我感受到的焦慮。

lines.en: I've been there, too. I've been there.
lines.zh: 我也經歷過，我經歷過。

lines.en: And And here's the thing that is hard to believe, but I'm going to say it anyway. Yeah.
lines.zh: 而這件事很難相信，但我還是要說。對。

lines.en: If you can get yourself out of bed and if you can get yourself out the door, you can do a little experiment where you can prove to yourself that you are powerful beyond measure.
lines.zh: 如果你能讓自己起床、能讓自己走出家門，你可以做一個小實驗，向自己證明你的力量大得無法衡量。

lines.en: In fact, I just did it this morning.
lines.zh: 事實上，我今天早上才做過。

lines.en: It was 5:55 and I had come out of the hotel and I was walking across a crosswalk and there was a woman that was walking that had her shoulders down and was looking at the ground and was like frowny face and walking and you know it's 5:55 and as I walked up to her I smiled and just said good morning and she perked right up and said well good morning and we just smiled and had this positive energy exchange.
lines.zh: 那時是 5 點 55 分，我走出飯店，正在過斑馬線，有一個女人走過來，肩膀垂著、看著地上、皺著臉走路，你知道，才 5 點 55 分。我走近她時，對她微笑說了聲早安，她馬上精神一振說：「嗯，早安！」我們就相視而笑，有了一次正能量的交流。

lines.en: And that tiny little thing that you miss that's right in front of your face is this enormous power that you have through your energy and your attitude to flip a switch inside somebody else.
lines.zh: 而那件你眼前很容易錯過的小事，就是你透過自己的能量和態度，擁有的巨大力量，能在別人心裡按下一個開關。

lines.en: I know. And when you do that, you are being of service.
lines.zh: 我知道。而當你這麼做，你就是在付出。

lines.en: And the energy that you're putting out, despite how horrible things may be that are going on in your life right now, it shows you and it shifts it.
lines.zh: 而你釋放出的能量，不管你現在生活中正發生多可怕的事，它都會讓你看見、並且改變它。

lines.en: Yes. Yeah. It doesn't pay the bills.
lines.zh: 對。對。它付不了帳單。

lines.en: It doesn't pay the bills, but it shifts something in you to know that you still have the power to positively impact somebody else.
lines.zh: 它付不了帳單，但它會改變你內在的某些東西，讓你知道你仍然有力量正面影響別人。

lines.en: And I think that's how it begins. Yeah.
lines.zh: 我想一切就是這樣開始的。對。

lines.en: At least that's how it began for me. Yeah. Is to notice.
lines.zh: 至少對我來說是這樣開始的。對。就是去注意。

lines.en: And you already said it. Every person Yes.
lines.zh: 而你已經說過了。每一個人，對。

lines.en: You listening, you have a platform.
lines.zh: 正在聽的你，你有一個平台。

lines.en: Your platform is your family, your roommate, the people that you work with.
lines.zh: 你的平台是你的家人、你的室友、你的同事。

lines.en: It's the person that you meet or you pass and don't smile to. Yeah.
lines.zh: 是你遇到或擦身而過卻沒對他微笑的那個人。對。

lines.en: And recognizing the power that you have to impact people positively is how you start to center yourself in a deeper source. That is number one.
lines.zh: 認清你有正面影響別人的力量，就是你開始讓自己扎根於更深源頭的方式。這是第一點。

lines.en: That certainly recognizing that. And the other really crucial thing is the religion that I practice which is gratitude.
lines.zh: 當然要先認清這一點。而另一件非常重要的事，是我所奉行的宗教，那就是感恩。

lines.en: I will tell you beyond a shadow of any doubt that I have for any human being who's listening to us right now that if you start a sincere consistent practice of gratitude your life will shift because it is energetically vibrationally um it causes your energy to change and the vibration to change and also what you then begin to attract into your life to change.
lines.zh: 我要毫無疑問地告訴每一個正在聽我們說話的人：如果你開始真誠、持續地練習感恩，你的人生就會轉變，因為在能量上、在振動上，它會讓你的能量和振動改變，也會讓你開始吸引到生命中的東西跟著改變。

lines.en: It's the single greatest thing anybody can do from where you are.
lines.zh: 這是任何人不論身在何處都能做的最重要的一件事。

lines.en: No matter how down you are, how stuck you are, is you start looking at what you have instead of what you haven't.
lines.zh: 不管你有多低落、多卡住，就是開始看你擁有的，而不是你沒有的。

lines.en: And you just practice it.
lines.zh: 然後就去練習。

lines.en: You just you just do five things.
lines.zh: 就、就寫下五件事。

lines.en: If you can't do five, do three.
lines.zh: 如果寫不到五件，就寫三件。

lines.en: And if you can't get to three, look at your breath. Breathe. Breathe. Breathe. You're still breathing.
lines.zh: 如果連三件都寫不到，就看看你的呼吸。呼吸，呼吸，呼吸。你還在呼吸。

lines.en: And I'm thinking for myself when I'm in uh in flow is when I'm in my period of gratitude.
lines.zh: 而我在想，對我自己來說，我處在順流的時候，就是我處在感恩狀態的時候。

lines.en: I am most in flow and my life most works most perfectly when I am in in the gratitude state.
lines.zh: 當我處在感恩的狀態，我最順流，我的人生也運作得最完美。

lines.en: This is the thing I know people listening to this think well okay easy to do because you're Oprah.
lines.zh: 我知道正在聽的人會想：嗯，好吧，對你來說很簡單，因為你是 Oprah。

lines.en: I got to be Oprah by doing that.
lines.zh: 我就是靠這樣做才成為 Oprah 的。

lines.en: M that's how I got to be where I am by doing that.
lines.zh: 嗯，我就是靠這樣才走到今天的。

lines.en: Um I you know I have I have had a practice of honoring that source that's greater than myself since I was a little girl.
lines.zh: 嗯，我、你知道，我從小女孩時就開始練習敬重那個比我更大的源頭。

lines.en: I mean I grew up speaking in the church and having the people say to my grandmother, "Hatty May, this here is a talking child.
lines.zh: 我是說，我從小在教會裡演講，大家會對我外婆說：「Hattie Mae，這孩子很會講話。

lines.en: You got yourself a talking child here."
lines.zh: 你家有個很會講話的孩子。」

lines.en: And so talking and using my voice and being able to express to other people and I realize now so people talk about what is your purpose?
lines.zh: 所以講話、運用我的聲音、能向別人表達，而我現在明白了。大家都在談：你的目的是什麼？

lines.en: What is your purpose? What is your purpose?
lines.zh: 你的目的是什麼？你的目的是什麼？

lines.en: How do you find your purpose?
lines.zh: 要怎麼找到你的目的？

lines.en: No matter who you are listening, if you were to pass away today, the people who eulogize you would connect the dots of your life and at your funeral or memorial service would talk about what you offered, what you brought to them.
lines.zh: 不管你是誰，正在聽的你，如果你今天過世了，那些為你致悼詞的人，會把你人生的點連起來，在你的葬禮或追思會上談你付出了什麼、帶給了他們什麼。

lines.en: And wherever you are in the journey, you are already creating a thread of purpose that flows through everything that you've done.
lines.zh: 而不管你走在旅程的哪個階段，你都已經在創造一條貫穿你所做一切的目的之線。

lines.en: And mine is inspiration and has been since I was four years old speaking in the Kosciusko church standing on a stage reciting and people saying my my my my little child can talk and then being a great an orator and winning all of the oratory contests when I was in school.
lines.zh: 我的是啟發，從我四歲在 Kosciusko 的教會站在台上朗誦、大家說「我的天，這孩子真會講話」開始就是如此，後來我成為很棒的演說者，在學校贏了所有演講比賽。

lines.en: That thread of speaking is what prepared me for the first audition when I sat down to do the radio show and then being recognized and brought into television.
lines.zh: 那條演說的線，讓我準備好第一次坐下來為廣播節目試音，後來被發掘、被帶進電視圈。

lines.en: That thread has led me to sitting the Mel Robbins podcast. Okay.
lines.zh: 那條線帶我來到 Mel Robbins podcast。好。

lines.en: That thread has brought me here today.
lines.zh: 那條線帶我來到今天這裡。

lines.en: And everyone listening to us has a thread. What's your thread? What is carried through?
lines.zh: 每個聽我們說話的人都有一條線。你的線是什麼？貫穿下來的是什麼？

lines.en: What is the thing or theme that has been through the course of your life? Mine is inspiration. What's yours? Encouragement. There you go. Yeah. Encouragement. Encouragement.
lines.zh: 你人生歷程中一直存在的那件事或那個主題是什麼？我的是啟發。你的是什麼？鼓勵。就是這樣。對。鼓勵。鼓勵。

lines.en: Yes. That's exactly what you do. Yeah.
lines.zh: 對，那正是你在做的事。對。

lines.en: Cuz I think it's easy to have the information or to get it. Yeah.
lines.zh: 因為我覺得擁有資訊或取得資訊很容易。對。

lines.en: But if you believe and convince yourself it won't work for you, Yeah. you won't do the things that change your life. That's the difference.
lines.zh: 但如果你相信、說服自己說這對你沒用，對，你就不會去做那些改變人生的事。這就是差別。

lines.en: That's what you do. And so I weave encouragement through everything because I know it's what I've always needed. Yeah.
lines.zh: 那就是你在做的事。所以我把鼓勵融入一切，因為我知道那是我一直都需要的。對。

lines.en: Because when you can't when you don't believe in yourself, being able to borrow somebody else's belief in your ability can really help.
lines.zh: 因為當你無法、當你不相信自己的時候，能借用別人對你能力的信任，真的很有幫助。

lines.en: And that's what encouragement that's what you do. Yeah. Girl, you're on it.
lines.zh: 那就是鼓勵，那就是你在做的事。對。你說對了。

lines.en: You know, there's a as you were talking about purpose, it reminded me of one of my favorite ways to think about purpose, which is that purpose is not the thing that you do.
lines.zh: 你知道，你在談目的的時候，讓我想到我最喜歡的一種看待目的的方式：目的不是你做的那件事。

lines.en: Purpose is the thing that happens in others when you do the thing you do.
lines.zh: 目的是當你做你所做的事時，在別人身上發生的事。

lines.en: Oo, I like that one.
lines.zh: 喔，我喜歡這句。

lines.en: I need to write that down.
lines.zh: 我要把它寫下來。

lines.en: Purpose is not the thing that you do.
lines.zh: 目的不是你做的那件事。

lines.en: Purpose is not the thing that you do. Yeah.
lines.zh: 目的不是你做的那件事。對。

lines.en: Purpose is the thing that happens in others when you do the thing that you do.
lines.zh: 目的是當你做你所做的事時，在別人身上發生的事。

lines.en: I love that, Miss Mel, because it it really weaves together what you were saying about how purpose doesn't have to be this big thing that you put on Instagram.
lines.zh: 我好喜歡，Mel 小姐，因為它真的把你剛說的串連起來：目的不一定是你放上 Instagram 的大事。

lines.en: It's actually something very quiet that you practice every day. Yeah.
lines.zh: 它其實是你每天都在實踐的、很安靜的東西。對。

lines.en: And it also ties in what Maya said to you about it's it's how you make people feel. Yeah.
lines.zh: 它也呼應了 Maya 跟你說的：重點在於你帶給人們什麼感受。對。

lines.en: And as you start doing the small thing, the small thing leads I think the problem.
lines.zh: 當你開始做那件小事，那件小事會帶來……我覺得問題是……

lines.en: One of the I actually do think it's a problem um with the way social media works is that I think a lot of people are just constantly bombarded with the lives of other people and trying to keep up with that.
lines.zh: 其中一個……我真的覺得社群媒體的運作方式是個問題，我覺得很多人一直被別人的生活轟炸，一直想跟上。

lines.en: Mh. And so you think your life is supposed to look like that and and it's just coming from every direction.
lines.zh: 嗯。所以你以為你的人生應該長那樣，而它從四面八方湧來。

lines.en: Every direction is telling you and you haven't gotten still enough with yourself.
lines.zh: 四面八方都在告訴你，而你還沒有讓自己夠安靜下來。

lines.en: The answers are not out there.
lines.zh: 答案不在外面。

lines.en: They just are not out there.
lines.zh: 它們就是不在外面。

lines.en: You know the voice of God.
lines.zh: 你知道上帝的聲音。

lines.en: God silence is the language of God.
lines.zh: 上帝……寂靜是上帝的語言。

lines.en: Silence is the language of God.
lines.zh: 寂靜是上帝的語言。

lines.en: And you can't hear it unless you are still enough, quiet enough within yourself.
lines.zh: 除非你內在夠安靜、夠平靜，否則你聽不到。

lines.en: The moment you're asking out there and asking everybody and what should I do and what should I do and what should I do?
lines.zh: 當你一直向外尋求、問每個人：我該怎麼辦？我該怎麼辦？我該怎麼辦？

lines.en: That's the moment that you get still.
lines.zh: 那就是你該靜下來的時刻。

lines.en: And even if still is just sitting on the toilet seat with the door closed, with the door closed.
lines.zh: 就算所謂的靜下來，只是關上門坐在馬桶蓋上。關上門。

lines.en: Well, for some of us, that's the only place that we can everybody just to be still, to be able to feel what that thing is.
lines.zh: 嗯，對我們有些人來說，那是唯一能讓大家都別來吵、能安靜下來的地方，才能感受那是什麼。

lines.en: It's trying to get through.
lines.zh: 它一直想傳達給你。

lines.en: There's nobody born that doesn't have it.
lines.zh: 沒有人生來沒有它。

lines.en: You know, I have a I have a very good friend who was giving advice to one of my daughters, funny enough, and he was saying to her, "Listen, you got a lot of gifts to give.
lines.zh: 你知道，我有一個非常好的朋友，說來好笑，他在給我其中一個女兒建議，他對她說：「聽著，你有很多天賦可以給予。

lines.en: Don't you dare show up in heaven with your pockets full with that song you didn't sing or that book you didn't write or that smile you didn't share.
lines.zh: 千萬不要帶著滿滿的口袋出現在天堂，裡面裝著你沒唱的歌、沒寫的書、沒分享的笑容。」

lines.en: Is there anything left that you're still wanting to share or teach?
lines.zh: 還有什麼是你仍然想分享或教導的嗎？

lines.en: Um, I was standing in the sphere in Las Vegas after the Bono concert and I'd gone with friends and we'd had the Bono and when it was all over,
lines.zh: 嗯，我那時站在拉斯維加斯的 Sphere，剛看完 Bono 的演唱會，我和朋友一起去的，看完 Bono 之後，

lines.en: I walked to the edge of where we'd been seating and they were all behind me and everybody was over to the side and they were all cheering each other because it was the first performance of U2, Bono at the Sphere.
lines.zh: 我走到我們座位區的邊緣，朋友們都在我後面，大家都在旁邊互相歡呼，因為那是 U2、Bono 在 Sphere 的首場演出。

lines.en: But I was standing alone on the side and I had that feeling, the same one I felt when I was 5 years old on the back porch.
lines.zh: 但我獨自站在旁邊，有了那種感覺，就跟我 5 歲時在後門廊感受到的一模一樣。

lines.en: And it was as clear to me.
lines.zh: 而它對我來說非常清楚。

lines.en: It said, "Wow, what just happened here?
lines.zh: 它說：「哇，這裡剛剛發生了什麼事？

lines.en: You could take people to the edge of the universe.
lines.zh: 你可以帶人們到宇宙的邊緣。

lines.en: You could use this stage, this screen, this window into the universe to allow people to connect to themselves in a way that they have never experienced before.
lines.zh: 你可以用這個舞台、這片螢幕、這扇通往宇宙的窗，讓人們以前所未有的方式和自己連結。

lines.en: You could connect them to the universe and to themselves and to each other.
lines.zh: 你可以讓他們和宇宙、和自己、和彼此連結。」

lines.en: That is what that feeling said to me.
lines.zh: 那就是那種感覺對我說的話。

lines.en: It was a voice and it was a feeling.
lines.zh: 那是一個聲音，也是一種感覺。

lines.en: And it was exactly the same as when I was 5 years old.
lines.zh: 而它和我 5 歲時一模一樣。

lines.en: It said, "Huh, this is an incredible arena, an incredible venue.
lines.zh: 它說：「嗯，這是一個不可思議的場地、不可思議的空間。

lines.en: I I didn't even know what I had just seen, but it's not being used to its maximum potential."
lines.zh: 我甚至不知道自己剛剛看到了什麼，但它沒有被發揮到最大的潛力。」

lines.en: You could use it to its maximum potential.
lines.zh: 你可以讓它發揮最大的潛力。

lines.en: How do you do that and share the experience of what it means to be fully alive with people?
lines.zh: 要怎麼做到這一點，並和大家分享全然活著是什麼樣的體驗？

lines.en: How do you connect people to the light within themselves using the tools of this space?
lines.zh: 要怎麼運用這個空間的工具，讓人們和內在的光連結？

lines.en: That's what the voice said to me.
lines.zh: 那就是那個聲音對我說的。

lines.en: This is this was 2023. Wow. 2023.
So almost three years ago.
lines.zh: 所以差不多三年前。

lines.en: It's almost three years ago.
lines.zh: 差不多三年前。

lines.en: And in the beginning, everybody thought was thinking of it as a show.
lines.zh: 一開始，大家都把它想成一場秀。

lines.en: And I was like, it's not a show. It's an experience.
lines.zh: 我說：這不是秀，是一場體驗。

lines.en: It's to be felt, not just seen.
lines.zh: 它是要用心去感受，不只是用眼睛看。

lines.en: How do we bring the team together that can create feelings for people?
lines.zh: 我們要怎麼集結一個能為人們創造感受的團隊？

lines.en: And so now three years later, this dream is being scored by one of the greatest musical composers on earth, Max Richter.
lines.zh: 所以三年後的現在，這個夢想由世界上最偉大的作曲家之一 Max Richter 配樂。

lines.en: So it's an immersive musical light experience of people coming together to ignite the light within ourselves.
lines.zh: 所以這是一場沉浸式的音樂燈光體驗，讓大家聚在一起，點燃我們內在的光。

lines.en: You know what I think is so amazing about this?
lines.zh: 你知道我覺得這哪裡最了不起嗎？

lines.en: And I want you to really consider everything that Oprah has poured into you and shared with you today.
lines.zh: 我希望你好好想想 Oprah 今天傾注給你、和你分享的一切。

lines.en: I think it's easy when you're standing in a moment and you look backwards. Yeah.
lines.zh: 我覺得當你站在某個時刻回頭看，很容易。對。

lines.en: To see how all the dots connect. Yeah.
lines.zh: 看出所有的點是怎麼連起來的。對。

lines.en: And it requires deep faith to stand in the present moment and believe that where you are is leading you somewhere. Yeah.
lines.zh: 而站在當下，相信你所在的地方正帶你前往某處，需要很深的信心。對。

lines.en: And it is much larger and grander than anything you could possibly imagine for yourself if you keep walking in that faith.
lines.zh: 而且只要你繼續帶著那份信心前進，它會比你為自己想像的任何事都更大、更宏偉。

lines.en: If you keep telling the truth.
lines.zh: 如果你繼續說真話。

lines.en: If you keep staying centered and grounded in your intention and you follow these fundamental laws that you have taught us.
lines.zh: 如果你繼續以你的意圖為中心、腳踏實地，遵循你教我們的這些基本法則。

lines.en: The energy you put out is the energy you get back.
lines.zh: 你釋放出什麼能量，就會得到什麼能量。

lines.en: I think it's really cool that even for somebody like you Yeah. who has achieved things that are beyond our wildest imaginations that here you are doing something that even 5 years ago was not even on your radar.
lines.zh: 我覺得很酷的是，即使是像你這樣的人，對，已經達成了超乎我們最狂野想像的成就，現在卻在做一件連五年前都不在你雷達上的事。

lines.en: Wasn't on my radar. Was not something you would have possibly imagined was a thing. No.
lines.zh: 不在我的雷達上。是你根本不可能想像到的事。沒錯。

lines.en: And so it proves yet again.
lines.zh: 所以這再次證明了。

lines.en: Yeah. how when you're clear about the way you're showing up and serving the world and you're clear about the reason why you're here, which is inspiration.
lines.zh: 對。當你清楚自己如何出現在世界上、如何服務世界，也清楚自己來這裡的原因，也就是啟發，

lines.en: Yeah. That life does rise up. Yeah.
lines.zh: 對，人生真的會為你升起。對。

lines.en: And I my my prayer has always been use me. Show me how. Show me. Show me. Show me. Show me. What is the next?
lines.zh: 而我、我的禱告一直都是：使用我。告訴我怎麼做。讓我看見。讓我看見。讓我看見。讓我看見。下一步是什麼？

lines.en: Is there a next? Oh, you just want me to rest? I'll do that,
lines.zh: 還有下一步嗎？喔，你只是要我休息？那我也會休息。

lines.en: too. uh by actually being in conversation with the life force within me has led me to the highest grounds possible for myself and I've been asking that how can I be used I mean I am 72 and very much aware of the urgency of time very much aware that I have one solid good decade left very much aware.
lines.zh: 呃，實際和我內在的生命力量對話，帶我走到了對我自己來說最高的境界，而我一直在問：我要怎麼被使用？我是說，我 72 歲了，非常清楚時間的緊迫，非常清楚我只剩下扎扎實實的十年，非常清楚。

lines.en: So I'm looking at my life as though I am going I have one solid decade left to give and offer the message that I came to give and to do it with clarity and do it with love and do it without ego and to do it as an offering to say this is why I came.
lines.zh: 所以我看待我的人生，就好像我只剩下扎實的十年，去給予、去傳達我來這裡要傳達的訊息，而且要清晰地做、帶著愛做、不帶自我地做，當作一份獻禮，說：這就是我來這裡的原因。

lines.en: I think we should all steal what you said when you said, "I believe I have a decade to do what I came to do." Yeah.
lines.zh: 我覺得我們都應該偷學你說的那句：「我相信我有十年去做我來這裡要做的事。」對。

lines.en: And I don't care how young or old you are.
lines.zh: 不管你是年輕還是年老。

lines.en: Imagine if you started living as if you had a decade.
lines.zh: 想像一下，如果你開始像只剩十年那樣生活。

lines.en: You had a decade to do what you came here to do.
lines.zh: 你有十年去做你來這裡要做的事。

lines.en: And how that focus shifts your intention.
lines.zh: 那份專注會如何改變你的意圖。

lines.en: You know, the big dream for me right now is the sphere,
lines.zh: 你知道，我現在最大的夢想是 Sphere，

lines.en: but I also realize in every day um in every in my everyday life that every encounter that people are that people are seeing me and that I feel like it is my responsibility to actually also see them as well.
lines.zh: 但我也明白，在每一天、在我日常生活的每一次相遇中，人們看見了我，而我覺得我也有責任去看見他們。

lines.en: It's beautiful. Yeah. I want to read to you page 79. Mhm.
lines.zh: 好美。對。我想為你讀第 79 頁。嗯。

lines.zh: 《我確實知道的事》。好。

lines.en: What did I know then?
lines.zh: 我那時知道什麼？

lines.en: Well, when you make loving others the story of your life, oh, there's never a final chapter because the legacy continues, you lend your light to one person and he or she shines it on another and another and another.
lines.zh: 嗯，當你把愛別人當成你人生的故事，喔，就永遠不會有最終章，因為傳承會延續下去，你把你的光借給一個人，他或她又把光照向另一個人、再另一個人、再另一個人。

lines.en: And I know for sure that in the final analysis of our lives, when the to-do lists are no more, when the frenzy is finished,
lines.zh: 而我確實知道，在我們人生最終的回顧裡，當待辦清單不再有、當忙亂結束、

lines.en: when our email boxes are empty, the only thing that will have any lasting value is whether we've loved others and whether they've loved us.
lines.zh: 當我們的信箱清空，唯一有持久價值的，是我們是否愛過別人，以及別人是否愛過我們。

lines.en: And I can tell you for sure that I know for sure that you loved us and we all love you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.

lines.zh: 我的臨別贈言是：「你生來就是為了在地球上實現你人生的夢想。

lines.en: You were born into this planet, into the density of this gravitational pull to fulfill the dream of your life and of the creator's dream of your life here on earth.
lines.zh: 你誕生在這個星球上、在這份重力的密度之中，是為了實現你人生的夢想，以及造物主為你這一生所懷的夢想。

lines.en: Get about the business of doing that. You heard her.
lines.zh: 好好去做這件事吧。」你聽到她說的了。

lines.zh: 好好去做這件事吧。

lines.zh: 沒錯，好好去做。

lines.en: I love you, Oprah Winfrey.
lines.zh: 我愛你，Oprah Winfrey。

lines.en: I love you too, Mel.
lines.zh: 我也愛你，Mel。

lines.en: Thank you for having me. Oh my gosh. Thank you. And thank you.
lines.zh: 謝謝你邀請我。天啊。謝謝你。也謝謝你們。

lines.en: Thank you for making the time.
lines.zh: 謝謝你撥出時間。

lines.zh: 謝謝你花時間和我、和 Oprah 在一起。

lines.zh: 也謝謝你慷慨地把這場對談分享給你生命中的人。

lines.en: It is a gift that you can give to other people that will inspire them, awaken them, remind them.
lines.zh: 這是你能送給別人的禮物，能啟發他們、喚醒他們、提醒他們。

lines.en: And in case no one else tells you today, as your friend, I wanted to be sure to tell you that I love you.
lines.zh: 如果今天沒有其他人跟你說，身為你的朋友，我想確定告訴你：我愛你。

lines.en: I believe in you. And I believe in your ability to create a better life.
lines.zh: 我相信你，我也相信你有能力創造更好的人生。

lines.zh: 現在，好好去把它做到吧。好好去做到。

lines.zh: 你能相信那一集就這樣發生了嗎？

lines.zh: 我是說，已經過了 24 小時，我現在坐回這張椅子上。

lines.en: I cannot believe Oprah was there.
lines.zh: 我還是不敢相信 Oprah 來過這裡。

lines.en: I'm so thrilled that you were here with us.
lines.zh: 我很開心你和我們一起在這裡。

lines.en: I know that it stirred something deep inside you.
lines.zh: 我知道它觸動了你內心深處的某些東西。

lines.en: And here's what I hope.
lines.zh: 而我希望的是這樣。

lines.en: I hope that you are generous with this episode. that if it awakened something in you, if you were reminded of something that you needed to hear,
lines.zh: 我希望你慷慨地分享這一集。如果它喚醒了你內在的某些東西，如果它提醒了你某件你需要聽到的事，

lines.en: that you copy and paste this link and you share this with everybody in your life because that episode of the Mel Robbins podcast is an offering to the world and to everybody that you love.
lines.zh: 請複製這個連結，分享給你生命中的每一個人，因為這一集 Mel Robbins podcast 是獻給全世界、獻給你所愛的每一個人的禮物。

lines.en: So, thank you in advance for being generous and helping us spread the power of good around the world. I really appreciate that.
lines.zh: 所以先謝謝你的慷慨，幫助我們把善的力量傳遍全世界。我真的很感謝。

lines.en: Okay, I know that now that you're inspired, you want to watch something else.
lines.zh: 好，我知道你現在充滿啟發，想再看點別的。

lines.en: This is going to be an extraordinary episode for you to watch next.
lines.zh: 這會是你接下來很值得看的精彩一集。

lines.en: And I'll welcome you in the moment you hit play.
lines.zh: 在你按下播放的那一刻，我就會歡迎你。
